map.PC 和树脂区别？: What is the difference between PC and resin?
map.PC 抗冲击极强、轻，但易刮需加硬膜；树脂（CR-39）舒适透光好、抗冲击弱，按: PC is extremely impact resistant and light but scratches easily so it needs a hard coating; resin (CR-39) is comfortable and transmits light well but has weak impact resistance, so choose by scenario.
map.能。增透+硬+防蓝光+变色可组合，但层数多成本与风险升，按需不堆砌。: Yes. Anti-reflective, hard, blue-light filtering and photochromic can be combined, but each extra layer raises the cost and risk, so add only what is needed.
